objective: Establish the permanent enterprise data and event foundation: one canonical versioned event envelope with a deterministic tenant-safe subject taxonomy, a PostgreSQL transactional outbox that commits business state and event intent atomically, a reliable JetStream publisher that confirms every publish and survives transient NATS outage, a durable consumer framework with explicit acknowledgement and bounded retry, durable PostgreSQL-backed consumer idempotency that makes at-least-once delivery duplicate-safe, an explicit dead-letter path for poison messages, an event schema and version registry, trusted server-side tenant provenance with Row-Level Security as the final boundary, reversible migrations, multi-architecture builds and a clean-room validation on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 — proven by unit, integration, concurrency, security, resilience and contract test matrices. Nexus AI guarantees at-least-once event transport; exactly-once transport is not claimed.
